purpose: Teach: 拳銃/失踪/濃縮/閉じ込め/荒廃/痴呆/損なわ/マルクス主義

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下の拳銃管理を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on wartime firearms regulation, didn't you?
lines.style: Steady, curious. Gentle opening. Warm eye contact. The intonation of someone genuinely interested in the answer, not testing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、政治家の失踪事件を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually wrote about the psychology of a politician's disappearance case.
lines.style: Careful, slightly self-conscious. A beat of hesitation before diving in. Respectful but honest correction. Voice steady underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、エキスを濃縮する古代技術を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you focused on ancient extraction techniques in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft, reflective tone. Not prodding — observing. The cadence of someone turning something over in their mind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、被害者を閉じ込めた事件の心理学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually examined the psychology of confinement in that case.
lines.style: Quiet correction without defensiveness. A small breath before the main clause. Respectful of her question but clear about what he actually did.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦後の都市荒廃の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper covered the urban decay of the postwar period, then?
lines.style: Patient, gently probing. Reflective tone continues. The rhythm of someone working through a small puzzle. Not accusatory — genuinely trying to understand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、痴呆症介護の社会学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually wrote about the sociology of dementia care.
lines.style: Steady voice. Polite but firm. He's settling into the pattern now — not flustered, just quietly correcting each time. Direct eye contact level maintained.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 健康を損なわぬ職場環境を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the healthy workplace environment — that was your focus, wasn't it?
lines.style: Engaged now, slightly warmer. A note of recognition in the voice. She's catching on to something. Quicker pace, more present.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、マルクス主義の思想史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No — my paper was on the intellectual history of Marxism.
lines.style: Clear, calm finale. He's no longer uncertain. A small smile in the voice without being smug. Direct answer without hesitation. Tone finally resolves.
